statements.quote: Growth in employee compensation expenses reflects the technical hires we’ve added this year, particularly AI talent.
statements.notes: AI talent is named as a driver of compensation expense growth, not quantified. 'This year' is not a named year, so fiscal_year is null and code applies the reported year (2025).

statements.quote: This includes 2026 hires to support our priority areas, particularly AI, as well as a full year of expenses from 2025 hires.
statements.notes: Describes drivers of expected 2026 employee compensation expense growth, with AI as a priority area. No amount or share is stated.

statements.quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $115-135 billion, with year-over-year growth driven by increased investment to support our Meta Superintelligence Labs efforts and core business.
statements.notes: Total capex guidance, including finance lease principal payments. Meta Superintelligence Labs (AI) is named as a driver of growth. This is not the AI portion.

statements.quote: The combined revenue run-rate of video generation tools hit $10 billion in Q4, with quarter -over-quarter growth outpacing the increase in overall ads revenue by nearly 3x.
statements.notes: This is a Q4 annualized run-rate of ads revenue from campaigns that use AI video generation tools. It is not a fiscal-year revenue figure. The AI link comes from the preceding sentence ('deploying AI to improve performance is ad creative'). Meta is a buyer, so this may not be AI revenue in the seller-side sense. Review before use.
